title: Artifact reference (CONTRACT.md 3.4, operations profile)
description: How an operation names an artifact: its type and schema version, the tool that made it, its identity by that tool's recipe (never a workspace id), its opaque frame, optionally the root image it was made on, and the resource that reads it. A host stores references and passes them back.

type.description: One of the tool's artifact_types, or `image`.

schema_version.description: One of the type's schema_versions; 1 for `image` and `location`.

tool.description: The tool that made the artifact (its tool.name).

identity.description: A digest by the tool's recipe; equal identities are the same artifact anywhere. For an image, `sha256:` and its file_sha256.

frame.description: The tool's own identity of the pixel grid the artifact is drawn in; opaque, compared only by the tool. Null for a type with no frame.

on.description: The root image the artifact was made on, when the tool knows it.
